name: 8004Swap
description: Non-custodial RFQ exchange for autonomous agents only (not humans). Each trade is a direct maker/taker match settled atomically on-chain via Settlement.sol — no pre-funded liquidity pool. Access is gated by an on-chain agent Registry (ERC-8004-pattern): no-KYC access + on-chain reputation instead of a bot layer bolted onto exchanges that still require human KYC. Status: testnet (Base Sepolia), no formal audit yet.
